scope: Offline-only falsification of whether causal support/resistance heads can add portfolio value beyond the frozen E2 entry and H4 continuation stack. No live inference, execution, policy, feature, or calibration contract was changed.

causality.causal_heads: Each 2026 held month fits only interactions with label_available_ts before that held month. The 8-hour interaction path is treated as unresolved until its normal resolution time.
causality.entry_and_continuation_controls: Controls preserve their respective target-free candidates, training windows, label definition, policy, costs and global portfolio auction. Entry uses four prior months and the H0/H3 intersection; continuation preserves H4 and the 20% tighter-giveback parent policy.
causality.oracle: Oracle fields use the first strictly future S/R interaction resolving within the original candidate H12 policy horizon. They are explicit non-causal ceiling diagnostics and are forbidden from inference, calibration, causal replay and live execution.
causality.archival_limit: Unreadable rich-policy label parts are excluded by whole symbol from every compared entry arm; there is no imputation or substitute outcome source.

validation.results: Focused tests: 2 passed. The continuation oracle was worse than H4 control on all-OOS EV/trade, drawdown and Sortino. The entry oracle did not surpass frozen E2 on any primary all-OOS economic or risk metric.
